items.title: Revolut unlocks Velocity Points
items.why: Fintech accounts are now plugging into airline loyalty currencies, a pattern that suggests transfer-partner talks with non-bank wallets are opening up.
items.summary_ai: Revolut customers can now access Velocity Points, linking the fintech to a major airline loyalty program.
items.take: Fintech accounts are now plugging into airline loyalty currencies, a pattern that suggests transfer-partner talks with non-bank wallets are opening up.
